packageBoundary.rule: This package defines mechanical interfaces and evidence requirements. It is not manufacturing geometry and cannot move the 240 exits, 14 fixed heads or canopy envelope.

arrangementPrinciples: Primary structural bearing/support, propulsion, direct-carrier braking, service locking, feedback and secondary retention are separate functional interfaces even if they share the same fixed canopy frame.
The 24 mm rotating-carrier value remains a coordination parameter and is not a permitted axial stack height for bearing/drive/brake/retention hardware.
Final axial and radial stack-up is not frozen until the selected bearing, drive, brake and retention concepts have controlled mating dimensions and tolerance data.
All rotating electronics remain prohibited under the current architecture; rotating feedback features are passive.
Any concept that requires moving a controlled cable exit or LED position becomes a controlled design-change proposal rather than an implicit packaging adjustment.
Service-removable items must be replaceable without destructive removal of the canopy or carrier.

interfaceZones.purpose: Carry primary gravity, radial and overturning loads between fixed structural frame and rotating hub/carrier.
fixedSide: machined or otherwise supplier-compliant bearing support ring

interfaceZones.purpose: Transmit propulsion torque from fixed drive to a dedicated rotating drive interface without becoming the primary support path.
rotatingSide: synchronous toothed ring or ring gear under qualification

interfaceZones.purpose: Provide a fixed-side power-off holding/fault-stop architecture that can act directly on the rotating carrier independently of a failed drive transmission where required by the released risk assessment.
fixedSide: spring-applied electrically released caliper or equivalent
rotatingSide: passive annular brake ring/disc attached to qualified carrier structure

interfaceZones.purpose: Provide a positive mechanical restraint for technician access after verified zero speed and isolation.
rotatingSide: dedicated receiver ring/lugs isolated from precision feedback and brake friction surfaces

interfaceZones.purpose: Arrest abnormal carrier separation/tilt after relevant primary support failure without routine normal-operation contact.
rotatingSide: multiple distributed passive capture features attached outside relevant primary-bearing fastener failure paths

interfaceZones.purpose: Measure actual carrier position/speed and provide index/overspeed plausibility while retaining powered electronics on the fixed side.
Provide controlled trim-mass adjustment without moving any cable exit.
mustNotBecomeLoadPath: service lock receiver unless specifically co-engineered and approved

interfaceZones.purpose: Reserve safe access for bearing, drive, brake, sensors, retention inspection and lock operation inside the canopy envelope.
